subject: Day 1 of your Pro trial: use one Buy Box on every listing
preheader: The same targets on every listing make the results comparable.
headline: Your Pro trial is on. Start with one real listing.
body: This email is about the trial period attached to your subscription checkout. While it runs, your account has Pro: the Offer Ceiling, Buy Box fit, the downside stress test, comparisons, and reports designed for review with your advisers or lender.

One useful practice is to screen every listing against the same Buy Box. Using the same targets each time can show which assumptions and criteria need refinement. Review the pricing and terms pages for current trial, renewal, cancellation, and refund terms.

For each property: review the inputs, check the Buy Box fit, note the Offer Ceiling and its target profile, then verify the assumptions that could change the result. The Offer Ceiling is not a recommended offer.
signature_note: The full path from screening to a submitted offer is written down at usetruecap.com/playbook.
